headline: Battle Lines Shift Across Contested Fronts
war_summary: The eighth day finds the war still without a victor, while the ledger shows its sharpest movement along several contested fronts. Endless Shore leads the latest account with 32 strategic-base events in 24 hours, including four neutralizations and captures by both factions; Drowned Vale follows with 20 events and activity still recorded in the latest two-hour window. Tempest Island has also remained busy, posting eight events in two hours and 16 across the day, while Marban Hollow registered seven in the latest two hours amid renewed casualty pressure. Farranac Coast has seen 16 events overall, though its immediate pace has eased. Loch Mor and Clahstra remain important unsettled sectors, with 11 events each in the day’s record for the former and eight for the latter; Clahstra’s fighting has gone quiet in the latest two-hour report after heavy earlier losses. Deadlands, Kings Cage and Stlican Shelf also show recent movement, but most quieter regions report no base changes. Casualty and enlistment rates broadly cooled in the latest hour, even as two-hour comparisons point to renewed activity on the principal fronts.
